chunks: Sitting with one’s knees drawn up in al-Masjid al-Haram is only disliked out of reverence for the Ka'bah.

key_terms.الِاحْتِبَاءُ: sitting with one’s knees drawn up and wrapped by one’s garment or arms
key_terms.تَعْظِيمًا: as an act of reverence and veneration
key_terms.لِلْكَعْبَةِ: for the Ka'bah, the sacred sanctuary
key_terms.يُكْرَهُ: is considered disliked in legal usage

ai.seo_question: Why is sitting with one’s knees drawn up disliked in al-Masjid al-Haram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning etiquette in al-Masjid al-Haram. It states that ihtiba' is disliked there specifically as an act of reverence and exaltation for the Ka'bah.
